notes.title: Meet Kireina!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
meet Foxy Kireina! In this new update, Sakura's story goes on (after completing her route at the Guild) and you get to meet Kireina.
Depending on your actions:
- Sakura and Kireina may become a couple
- Both can become permanently recruitable companions
- There are romantic events for a protagonist that is interested in them
Only one sad note, this update does not keep (backwards) track if you had a romantic time with Sakura, so some dialogue options won't appear if you already went on a date with her before the update.

notes.title: Version 2.0: New game plus, post game and male romances
notes.content:
New version is up!
This version is labelled 2.0 and includes:
[b]- Post-game rooms with all recruitable characters and bosses in the game
- Post-game section with powerful bosses to test your best team!
- New game plus bonuses (unfortunately, for those of you who already have completed the game, it's necessary that you beat the last boss again and reach the post-game rooms)
- New male romances: Rudy and Roine[/b]
Let me know if you find any bugs by commenting below or reaching out to: gardenofdreamsrpg@gmail.com
And I will fix them right away!
Thank you for playing Dungeon Dreams and have fun!

notes.title: Update online!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone,

thank you for betatesting Dungeon Dreams [/b]with your Kickstarter keys.
Even though we did extensive testing, due to the nature of the game (many multilple branches and open quests), some bugs still remained.
Thank to some of you, we've been able to find them and upload a new update (version 1.1) 

Some fixes include:
[i]Hendel’s ritual movement bug 
Elasul portrait at the Cemetery
Rain during wedding scene
Fixed walkable tile at home (upgraded)
Recruiting wife fixed
Rose showing up at the beach
Ark's enemy coming back twice
Fiona “wedding crash” bug
Profile Clicks on Lovely Charm menu
Fixed Phillip’s conversation loop bug
Fixed Irastikaan’s message loop
Recruiting Lucius and Caecily bug.
Typos, language and similar.[/i]
